run_train_lcm_lora_sd: run the training script to distill latent consistency models with LoRA on Stable Diffusion using webdataset shards
create_sd_text2image_dataset: create a webdataset-based text-to-image dataset with configurable resolution, interpolation, and shuffle buffer
build_lora_config_unet: build a LoRA configuration for the UNet student model with configurable rank, alpha, dropout, and target modules
test_ddim_solver: test the DDIM ODE solver class that samples timesteps and runs one-step DDIM sampling for consistency distillation
summarize_kohya_state_dict: summarize how to convert a PEFT LoRA state dict to the Kohya SS format for saving and loading Stable Diffusion LoRA weights
